queue.title: Breadth-vs-depth progressive proposal widening
queue.hypothesis: Given that extra lookahead depth has not improved the primary metric, allocating additional compute to a wider, epistemically diverse root proposal set will improve causal recovery more efficiently than deeper search.
queue.design: At each step generate 1, 2, or 4 independent five-designer proposal sets using isolated proposal RNG streams, deduplicate concrete interventions, score all retained proposals with the same one-step expected-gain evaluator, and choose the best. Compare width-1, width-2, and width-4 under equal experiment budget with compute accounting and RNG-isolated observations.
queue.primary_metric: Pareto performance over edge error and compute time

queue.title: Unconditional three-step or MCTS epistemic search
queue.reason: Unconditional depth and two depth-gating schemes failed to justify compute.

queue.title: Parallel designer proposals plus selective search
queue.hypothesis: If breadth helps, learn how to allocate proposal-generation effort across epistemically distinct designers rather than uniformly widening all of them.

queue.title: Reward and credit assignment ablation
queue.hypothesis: Counterfactual or trajectory-aware credit can improve policy learning once proposal-value estimates are available.

queue.title: Model misspecification transfer
queue.hypothesis: A controller that succeeds only when its Bayesian world class is correct will degrade under nonlinear, confounded, imperfect-intervention, or nonstationary worlds; model-uncertainty mechanisms should reduce that degradation.

dynamic_enqueue_rules: Every completed experiment must generate at least one next candidate unless a stronger queued candidate already tests the same uncertainty.
Falsification never empties the queue; it narrows or redirects it.
Do not enqueue equivalent retries without a changed causal hypothesis, state representation, reward, search depth, world model, or evaluation design.
Promote surprising anomalies and control victories into diagnostic experiments.
Maintain matched resource budgets and preserve all negative results.
